name: Leil Schwar
source:
The Captain

The Captain of the “Settler.”
The daughter of a military family, she was promoted at an exceptionally young age due to her rare military talentand has experience commanding various ships in the past.
She is deeply trusted by the crew,and she, in turn, trusts them wholeheartedly.
She is married and has a husband on Earth, but for certain reasons, she is having an affair with First Officer John, and continues the relationship despite feeling guilty.
